metric_definitions.error_rate: Alias of terminal_error_rate: trials containing normalized runtime/startup/cleanup diagnostics divided by all trials; recovered tool failures are separate.
metric_definitions.terminal_error_rate: Trials with one or more normalized terminal/runtime diagnostics divided by all trials.
metric_definitions.tool_errors: Distinct failed tool invocation identities in the retained normalized trace.
metric_definitions.tool_error_rate: Distinct failed tool invocations divided by observed tool calls; unknown when no tool calls were observed.
metric_definitions.trials_with_recovery_rate: Trials containing one or more recovery events divided by all trials; does not assert successful recovery.

limitations: Exact source/AST evaluation measures small canonical transformations, not production behavior.
Configured model revisions are declared controls; revision verification is reported per trial.
Reported token limits cannot undo billed usage; hard limits require an affirmative backend capability.
Temporary repositories isolate artifacts; they are not an OS sandbox.
Synthetic replay results are runtime regression evidence, not model quality or paid-provider performance.
